purpose: Toolchain, solver and library provenance for the IVG initial Verus uplift (2026-11-13).

bank_of_ziniu_pin.note: bank-of-ziniu setup-verus.sh pins this release (vstd crate =0.0.0-2026-09-20-0158). The experiment environment selects the newer 0.2026.10.04 release. The models here use only the bundled vstd of the selected binary and no bank-of-ziniu crate, so no library from the bank pin is linked. Cross-runs with the bank pin are recorded in the runbook when performed.

libraries_used.vstd: bundled with the selected Verus binary (no crates.io resolution)
libraries_used.G5Labs/actors: not used: the modeled participants are one IRIS namespace's processes sharing globals under the ledger head lock; no actor contract was instantiated
libraries_used.pgspec: not applicable: the product runs on InterSystems IRIS, not PostgreSQL
libraries_used.explorer: not linked; bounded exploration is done by verified exhaustive enumeration inside the Verus models (see runbook)
